jsonld_raw.name: ELEGANTLY TOKYO SOLID PERFUME 4.3G (0.14 OZ)
jsonld_raw.description: A solid perfume scented with the Elegantly Tokyo fragrance, perfect for carrying with you and reapplying throughout the day. Pair it with the Eau de Parfum for a more immersive olfactory experience. Inspired by the balance between tradition and modernity that defines Tokyo, this fragrance combines the brightness of white flowers and jasmine with the contemporary depth of akigalawood. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves. Floral | Serene, luminous, and structured
